info.name: Board Foresight API - V1 Alert DiscoverJob API

items.docs: Retrieves a list of v2 discover jobs

info.name: Searches latest discover results for a given definition id

params.name: definitionId
params.description: Definition id for the discover job (found in app url for discover job or discover/jobs endpoint)

params.name: Query
params.description: String query identical to the search box in the application, defaults to *

params.name: PageSize
params.description: Desired page size, maximum of 1000 defaults to 20

params.name: Frequency
params.description: Setting this will return only indicators with a matching base Frequency, blank ignores the filter

params.name: Seasonality
params.description: Setting this will return only indicators with matching Seasonality, blank ignores the filter

params.name: InternalOnly
params.description: Setting this flag to true will only return internal indicators, default is false

params.name: Classification
params.description: Setting this will return only indicators with matching Classification, blank ignores the filter

params.name: MinimumOverlap
params.description: Minimum overlap percentage filter, Defaults to 100

items.docs: Searches latest discover results for a given definition id
